metadata.description: Decision skills for agents, published with the evidence that earned them a verdict: an evaluation harness, four arms per item, and a scorecard that stays empty until a confirmation run fills it.

plugins.name: decision-making-skills
plugins.description: Decision skills for agents, each shipped with the evidence for or against it. One skill routes to six procedures; it appears here only after a confirmation run in the evaluation harness assigns it a verdict, so an UNTESTED skill cannot be promoted here.
